title: Hawksbill Creek agreement and Devco

tellings.quote: Something happened down there where a group of people had done what was called the Hawksbill Creek agreement.

plain: A researcher named Jason Simosa tells Michels that something happened in the Bahamas sometime between the 1950s and the late 1960s. He says a group of people made a deal there that was "called the Hawksbill Creek agreement." The title also pairs the deal with something called Devco, and Simosa gives no source and says little more about either one.
